en: Then the king Dhritarashtra said to Duryodhana who was seated along with his brothers and surrounded by other kings,

sa: यस्ते युद्धमयं दधैं कामं च व्यपनाशयेत्। सोऽहं जातो महाबाहो भीष्मः परपुरंजयः। व्यपनेष्यामि ते दर्प युद्धे राम न संशयः॥
en: He, who will remove your boasts of velour and desire for war, is now born. He is myself, Bhishma, the subjugator of hostile cities and I shall destroy your pride in battle. There is no doubt about it.

sa: चलतस्तस्य कायात् तु शिरो ज्वलितकुण्डलम्। सोष्णीयं सशिरस्त्राणं क्षुरप्रेण त्वपातयद्॥
en: Then with a razor-sharpened arrow he sundered from body his head still trembling with shining ear-rings, crown and headprotector.

sa: उद्यानान्निर्गताः सर्वे भ्रातरो भ्रातभिः सह। तत्रैकस्तु महाबाहुर्भीमो नाभ्येति मामिह॥
en: The others with all their brothers have returned from the gardens; only my mighty arined Bhima has not come.

sa: अतोषयन् महाराजमकुर्वन् वा पितुर्वचः। मुहूर्तमपि नेच्छेयं जीवितुं कुपिते नृपे॥
en: Dissatisfying the king, disregarding his words and offending him, I do not want to breathe for a single moment.

sa: सर्वकामसमृद्धं च प्रादादनं गयस्तदा। ब्राह्मणेभ्यः प्रहृष्टेभ्यः सर्वभूतेभ्य एव च॥
en: Then Gaya gave to the delighted Brahmanas and other creatures, those stakes and many other precious objects of desire.

sa: अश्विनावपि तद् राजन् सरः प्राविशता तदा। ततो मुहूर्तादुत्तीर्णाः सर्वे ते सरसस्तदा।॥ दिव्यरूपधराः सर्वे युवानो मृष्टकुण्डलाः। तुल्यवेषधराश्चैव मनसः प्रीतिवर्धनाः॥
en: O king, the two Ashvins also entered into the lake. A few minutes after they all came out from the lake, becoming exceedingly beautiful, young and wearing brilliant car-rings, all assuming the same appearance delightful to the heart.

sa: सेनाग्रगा मन्त्रिसुताः किंकरा रावणात्मजः। एते हनुमता तत्र एकेन वितिपातिताः।।६।
en: What to speak of more, Hanuman, singlehanded, slew Ravana's commander-in-chief, the minister's son, his servants and his one son.

sa: सेयमित्यवगच्छामि नानृतं वक्तुमुत्सहे। नानृतं हि सदा लोके पूज्यते दानवोत्तम॥
en: This is she, I cannot tell a falsehood. O best of Rakshasa, falsehood is never respected in this world.

sa: अथ रामो महाप्राज्ञो विश्वामित्रं महामुनिम्। पप्रच्छ प्राञ्जलिर्भूत्वा विशालामुत्तमां पुरीम्॥
en: Then the highly wise Rāma, with folded hands, asked that mighty ascetic Viśvāmitra concerning the excellent city of Viśālā.

sa: तां ततः सम्परिष्वज्य विलपन्ती तपस्विनीम्। व्यपनिन्युः सुदुःखाता कौसल्यां व्यावहारिकाः॥
en: As embracing the (dead) body, that unfortunate lady was bewailing, the courtiers had the distressed (queen) removed from there.

sa: इक्ष्वाकोस्तु प्रसादेन सर्वे वैशालिका नृपाः। दीर्घायुषो महात्मानो वार्यवन्तः सुधार्मिकाः॥
en: And by the grace of Ikşvāku, all the sovereigns of Viśālā are long-loved, and highsouled, and puissant, and pious.

sa: रामश्च हि महातेजा महासत्त्वो महाबलः। अपि राक्षसलोकस्य भवेदन्तकरोऽपि हि॥
en: Truely is that highly intelligent and effulgent Rāma of mighty prowess, like death itself to the rangers of night.

sa: सुमालिनं हतं दृष्ट्वा वसुना भस्मसात्कृतम्। स्वसैन्यं विद्रुतं चापि लक्षयित्वादितं सुरैः॥ ततः स बलवान्क्रुद्धो रावणस्य सुतस्तदा। निवर्त्य राक्षसान्सन्मेिघनादो व्यवस्थितः॥
en: Beholding Sumali slain and reduced to ashes by Vasu and being assailed by the deities the Räksasa host fled into diverse directions. And collecting all the Rākşasas stood there the highly powerful Meghanāda, enraged, the son of Ravana.

sa: यशो वर्थो भगश्चैव विजयः सिद्धतेजसः। एवमेवानुवर्तन्ते सप्त ज्योतींषि भास्करम्॥
en: Glory, effulgence, greatness, enlightenment; victory, perfection, and energy, these seven always follow this same like rays following the sun.

sa: ते रामं पर्णशालायामुपविष्टं महाबलम्। ददृशुः सीतया सार्धं लक्ष्मणेनापि सेवितम्॥
en: And they saw the mighty Rāma seated in the cottage in company with Sītā, and ministered to by Laksmana.

sa: ततः शूर्पणखा घोरा राघवाश्रममागता। राक्षसानाचचक्षे तौ भ्रातरौ सह सीतया॥
en: Then the grim Śūrpanakhā, coming to Rāghava's asylum pointed out to the Rākşasas those brother in company with Sītā.

sa: तयोहि दर्शनं नैतन्मिथ्या भवितुमर्हति। अचिरेणैव मे पुत्रा भस्मीभूता जनार्दन॥
en: The interviews of those persons could never be useless. Soon, O Janarddana, have my sons been reduced to ashes!'

sa: तथा वदति काकुत्स्थे अवधानपरायणाः। उद्विग्नमनसः सर्वे किं नु राजाभिधास्यति॥
en: Rāma, the descendant of Kakutstha having said this, they, with anxiety and attention, awaited the orders of the king.

sa: अवश्यं नरकस्तात द्रष्टव्यः सर्वराजभिः॥ शुभानामशुभानां च द्वौ राशी पुरुषर्षभ।
en: Hell, O son, should, forsooth, be seen by every king. There is enough of good and bad, O king.

sa: ततो दुर्योधनो राजा भीमसेनं महाबलम्। नाराचेन सुतीक्ष्णेन भृशं मर्मण्यताडयत्॥
en: Then king Duryodhana shortly wounded the mighty Bhima in his very vital parts with a Naracha of exceeding sharpness.

sa: पाट्यमानेषु कुम्भेषु पार्श्वेष्वपि च वारणाः। प्रासैर्विनिहताः केचिद् विनेदुः परमातुराः॥
en: Being struck on their frontal globes and flanks, and mangled by lances, many elephants roared aloud in great agony.

sa: इदमप्यृषिभिर्दृष्टं निर्याणमिति मे मतिः। सम्यगापः प्रवक्ष्यामि न चेत्पश्यामि जानकीम्॥
en: I think the sages have enjoyed another way of exit. I shall, failing to see Janaki, enter into water.

sa: ध्रुवं तु रक्षोबहुला भविष्यति वनाकुला। अशोकवनिका पुण्या सर्वसंस्कारसंस्कृता ॥
en: The sacred Asoka wood, sanctified with every purifying rite and abounding in woods, needs must be full of Rāksas.

sa: तस्य तद् वचनं श्रुत्वा शङ्खस्य लिखितस्तदा। अवगाह्यापगां पुण्यामुदकार्थं प्रचक्रमे॥
en: Hearing these words of Shankha, Likhita performed his ablutions in the sacred river and began to perform the water-rite.

sa: मुनेस्तु भाषितं श्रुत्वा लक्ष्मणः परवीरहा। अभिवाद्य महात्मानं वाक्यमेतदुवाच ह॥
en: Hearing the words of the ascetic, Laksmana, the slayer of enemies worshipping the feet of that high-souled one, said.

sa: तच्छ्रुत्वा हर्षमापेदे राघवो भ्रातृभिः सह। वाक्यं चाद्भुतसंकाशं भ्रातृन्प्रोवाच राघवः॥
en: Hearing the wonderful words of Bharata both Rāma and Lakşmaņa were greatly delighted. And then Rāma said to Lakşmaņa.

sa: पितृष्वस्रीयाय स तामनपत्याय भारत। अग्यमग्रे प्रतिज्ञाय स्वस्यापत्य स सत्यवाक्॥ अग्रजामथ तां कन्यां शूरोऽनुग्रहकांक्षिणे। प्रददौ कुन्तिभोजाय सखा सख्ये महात्मने।॥
en: O descendant of the Bharata race, that truthful man (Shura) give his first born child to the son of his paternal aunt, his childless cousin and favour seeking friend, the high-souled Kuntibhoja, according to a promise given before.

sa: अथ चेन्मानुषे लोके कदाचिदुपपद्यते। तत्र दीर्घायुरुत्पन्न: स नरः सुखमेधते॥
en: If such a person is ever born in the world of men, he becomes longlived and enjoys great happiness.

sa: स त्वं पापमति क्रूरं पापचित्तमचेतनम्। अनुशाधि दुरात्मानं स्वयं दुर्योधनं नृपम्॥
en: Therefore do yourself instruct the ruler of men, Duryodhana, of wicked soul crooked of evil intellect, of sinful heart and senseless.

sa: ततस्त्रिविष्टपं गच्छेत् त्रिषु लोकेषु विश्रुतम्। तत्र वैतरणी पुण्या नदी पापप्रणाशिनी॥
en: One should then go to Trivistapa, celebrated all over the three worlds. There flows the sacred and the sin-destroying Vaitarani river.

sa: श्वा चैवानुययावेकः प्रस्थितान् पाण्डवान् वनम्। क्रमेण ते ययुर्वीरा लौहित्यं सलिलार्णवम्॥
en: While the Pandavas started for the forest a dog followed them, Proceeding on, those heroes reached the sea of red waters.

sa: गच्छ द्वैतवनं शीघ्रं पाण्डवान् पापपूरुषान्। निमन्त्रय यथान्यायं विप्रांस्तस्मिन् वने तदा॥
en: "Go soon to the forest of Dvaitavana and in that forest duly invite the Brahmanas and those wicked men, the Pandavas.

sa: उत्सादनार्थं लोकानां धुन्धुर्नाम महासुरः॥ तपस्यति तपो घोरं शृणु यस्तं हनिष्यति।
en: A great Asura, named Dhundhu, is now undergoing severe austerities in order to destroy the world. Hear who will kill him.

sa: तेषां तु गच्छतां शीघ्रं सर्वेषां योगधर्मिणाम्। याज्ञसेनी भ्रष्टयोगा निपपात महीतले॥
en: As those powerful ones were proceeding quickly all rapt in Yoga, Yajnaseni, falling off from Yoga, dropped down on the Earth.

sa: पूर्वं परीक्षितो हि त्वं प्रश्चाद् द्वैतवने मया। अरणीसहितस्यार्थे तच्च निस्तीर्णवानसि॥
en: Before this, I had examined you in the Dvaita forest by my questions, when your brothers with Draupadi had fallen down.

sa: सोदर्येषु विनष्टेषु द्रौपद्या तत्र भारत। श्वरूपधारिणा तत्र पुनस्त्वं मे परीक्षितः॥
en: Assuming the shape of a dog, I examined you once more, O son when your brothers with Draupadi had fallen down.

sa: चातुर्वण्र्यं भगवता पूर्वं सृष्टं स्वयम्भुवा। केन कर्मविपाकेन वैश्यो गच्छति शूद्रताम्॥
en: Forinerly, the illustrious self-create created the four castes. Through the evil result of what deeds does a Vaishya became a Shudra?

sa: गङ्गा देवनदी पुण्यां पावनीमृषिसंस्तुताम्। अवगाह्य ततो राजा तनुं तत्याज मानुषीम्॥
en: Having bathed in the celestial river Ganga, acred and purifying and ever worshipped by the Rishis, he renounced his human body.

sa: बृहस्पतिर्मन्त्रविद्धि जजाप च जुहाव च। एवं स्कन्दस्य महिषीं देवसेनां विदुर्जनाः॥
en: Brihaspati learned in Mantras performed all necessary prayers and oblations. Thus Devasena became known amongst men as the wife of Skanda.

sa: सत्कारमानपूजार्थं तपो दम्भेन चैव यत्। क्रियते तदिह प्रोक्तं राजसं चलमध्रुवम्॥
en: Raja Penance is that which is performed with hypocrisy for gaining respect honour, and revenue, and which is unstable and transient.

sa: नारायणं नमस्कृत्य नरं चैव नरोत्तमम्। देवी सरस्वती व्यासं ततो जयमुदीरयेत्।।
en: Having saluted Narayana and Nara the best of mal beings, as also Sarasvati the Goddess of learning, let us cry success.

sa: ततो निवृत्य राजेन्द्र तेषामर्थे सरस्वती। भूयः प्रतीच्यभिमुखी प्रसुस्राव सरिद्वरा॥ अमोघा गमनं कृत्वा तेषां भूयो व्रजाम्यहम्। इत्युद्भुतं महचक्रे तदा राजन् महानदी॥
en: Having thus, O king, changed her course for their sake, the Sarasvati, that best of rivers, once more flowed in a westerly direction, to make the arrival of the Rishis there successful. O king, the great river accomplished there this wonderful feat.

sa: तं शब्दमभिनिध्याय राक्षसी क्रोधमूर्छिता। श्रुत्वा चाभ्यद्रवत् क्रुद्धा यत्र शब्दो विनिःसृतः॥
en: And rendered almost insensible by anger, that Räksasī furiously rushed in a main towards the spot whence had come the report.

sa: संजय उवाच ततो दुर्योधनो राजा मोहात् प्रत्यागतस्तदा। शरवर्षेः पुनर्भीमं प्रत्यवारयदच्युतम्॥
en: Sanjaya said Thereafter king king Duryodhana, having regained his senses, once more opposed the invincible Bhima with a shower of arrows.

sa: अश्विनोस्तु तथा स्थाने दीप्यमानौ स्वतेजसा। नकुलं सहदेवं च ददर्श कुरुनन्दनः॥
en: In the place belonging to the Ashvins the delighter of the Kuru saw Nakula and Sahadeva, each blazing with own effulgence.

sa: एवं स्तुत्वा स विप्रर्षिरुत्तङ्को भुजगोत्तमान्। नैव ते कुण्डले लेभे ततश्चिन्तामुपागमत्॥
en: After having thus praised the chief Nagas, the Brahmana Rishi, Uttanka did not get his ear-rings; and he became very thoughtful.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच एतद् वचनमाज्ञाय भीमसेनोऽत्यमर्षणः। बभूव विमनास्त्रस्तो न चैवोवाच किंचन॥
en: Vaishampayana said : Having heard these words, the impetuous Bhimasena became alarmed and pensive; and he did not utter a word.

sa: कस्मिंश्चित् कारणे तत्र विस्मितो यदुनन्दनः। निवृत्ता हेतुना केन कथमेव सरिद्वरा॥
en: Why was that delighter of the Yadus filled with wonder? Why, indeed did that best of rivers thus change her course."

sa: स त्वं तातानुपायेन लिप्ससे भरतर्षभ। आधिराज्यं महद् दापितं प्रथितं सर्वराजसु॥
en: You however, my dear friend, desire to get by improper means a greatly extensive kingdom well known among all the kings.

sa: एवं नल: सान्त्वयित्वा भ्रातरं सत्यविक्रमः। स्वपुरं प्रेषयामास परिष्वज्य पुनः पुनः॥
en: Having thus accosted his brother, Nala of undaunted courage embraced him repeatedly and asked him to go to his own city.

sa: प्रविश्य च नागलोकं स्वभवनमगच्छत्। अथोत्तङ्कस्तस्याः क्षत्रियाया वचः स्मृत्वा तं तक्षकमन्वगच्छत्॥
en: Entering the region of the Nagas, he proceeded to his Own home. Uttanka, remembering the words of the queen, pursued Takshaka.

sa: भीष्मः सैन्येन महता समन्तात् परिवारितः। ययौ प्रकर्षन् महतीं वाहिनीं सुरराडिव॥
en: Then, like the lord of the celestial (Indra), Bhishma surrounded by innumerable troops, advanced at the head of a mighty army,

sa: अभिषिच्य स्वराज्ये च राजानं च परिक्षितम्। दुःखार्तश्चाब्रवीद् राजा सुभद्रा पाण्डवाग्रजः॥ एष पुत्रस्य पुत्रस्ते कुरुराजो भविष्यति। यदूनां परिशेषश्च वज्रो राजा कृतश्च ह॥
en: Installing Parikshit also on their throne, as king, the eldest brother of the Pandavas, filled with sorrow, addressed Subhadra, saying, 'This son of your son will be the king of the Kurus. The survivor of the Yadus, viz., Vajra, has been made a king.

sa: अवध्याः पाण्डवाः कृष्ण सर्व एव त्वया सह। मुक्ता द्रोणभीष्माभ्यां कर्णाद् वैकर्तनात् कृपात्॥३० दुर्योधनाद् द्रोणसुतात् सैन्धवाच्च जयद्रथात्। सोमदत्ताद् विकर्णाच शूराच कृतवर्मणः॥
en: The Pandavas, O Krishna, as well as yourself, are surely unslayable, since they are you have escaped from Drona, Bhishma, Karna the son of Vikartana, Kripa, Duryodhana, the of son Drona, the mighty car-warrior Jayadratha, Somadatta, Vikarna, and from the brave Kritavarman.

sa: परुषं दारुणं तीक्ष्णं क्रूरमिन्द्रियतापनम्। सीतानिमित्तं दुर्वाक्यं श्रुत्वा स न भविष्यति॥
en: Hearing harsh, terrible, unsufferable, fierce and foul words concerning Sītă, calculated to set the senses on fire, he shall not exist.

sa: इत्युक्त्वा धर्मराजः स वासुदेवस्य धीमतः। मातुलस्य च वृद्धस्य रामादीनां तथैव च॥ भ्रातृभिः सह धर्मात्मा कृत्वोदकमतन्द्रितः श्राद्धान्युद्दिश्य सर्वेषां चकार विधिवत् तदा॥
en: Having said these words, king Yudhishthira, the just, alone with his brothers, promptly offered oblations of water to Vasudevas of great intelligence, as also his old maternal uncle, and Rama add others. He then duly performed the Shraddhas of all those kinsmen.

sa: मातृतीर्थं च तत्रैव यत्र स्नातस्य भारत। प्रजा विवर्धते राजन्नतन्वीं श्रियमश्नुते॥
en: O descendant of Bharata, O king, there is also Matri Tirtha, bathing in which one obtains large progeny and great prosperity.

sa: भयं च महदुद्दिश्य त्रासिताः कुरवो मया। क्रुद्धेन भूत्वा तु पुनर्यथावदनुदर्शिताः॥
en: I frightened them, filled with anger referring to some great fear. But once more I showed themselves my usual human forin.

sa: नारायणं नमस्कृत्य नरं चैव नरोत्तमम्। देवी सरस्वती व्यासं ततो जयमुदीरयेत्।।
en: Having saluted Narayana and Nara the best of male beings as also Sarasvati, the goddess of learning let us cry success.

sa: हस्त्यश्वस्थयानानि वाहनानि विशेषतः। कटके कुण्डले चैव ब्रह्मसूत्रं तथा परम्॥ वस्त्रं चैव विचित्रं च गन्धं चैव विशेषतः। देववत् पूजयेत् तं तु विष्णुलोकमवाप्नुयात्॥
en: Elephants and horses and and conveyances, especially animals and the vehicles they draw, a bracelet of gold a pair of ear-rings, sacred threads, beautiful dresses, and perfumes in especial (should be give). By adoring him as a deity one acquires the regions of Vishnu.

sa: याच्यमानं मया मूढ पित्र्यमंशं न दित्ससि॥ पाण्डवेभ्यः स्वराज्यं च लोभाच्छकुनिनिश्चयात्।
en: Requested by me, O fool, you did not, from avarice, give the Pandavas their paternal share, under the advice of Shakuni.

sa: देवस्य च गुहस्यापि देव्या नन्दीश्वरस्य च। बलिं सुविहितं कृत्वा दमेन नियमेन च॥ ततस्तु युक्तो गृह्णयानामान्याशु यथाक्रमम्। ईप्सितालँभते सोऽर्थान् भोगान् कामांश्च मानवः।।२०२
en: That man gains all objects of enjoyment and pleasure and all things that are desired by him, who, practising self-control, makes, according to proper rites, offerings to Mahadeva, Guha, Uma, and Nandi, and thereafter utters forthwith their names, in proper order and with devotion.

sa: नारायणं नमस्कृत्य नरं चैव नरोत्तमम्। देवी सरस्वतीं व्यासं ततो जयमुदीरयेत्।।
en: Having saluted Narayana and Nara the best of male beings, as also Sarasvati the God of Learning, let us cry success.

sa: मध्यमः पाण्डवस्तीक्ष्णो भीमसेनो महाबलः। प्रतिज्ञातं च तेनोग्रं भज्येतापि न संनमेत्॥
en: The second son of Pandu, Bhimascna, is highly powerful. He has taken a terrible vow. He will break but not bend.

sa: ममेदं लङ्घनं व्यर्थं सागरस्य भविष्यति। प्रवेशश्चैव लङ्कायां राक्षसानां च दर्शनम्॥
en: This my bounding over the main comes to nought; as also my entry into Lank, and the sight of the Rākşasas.

sa: इरावांस्तु रणे क्रुद्धो भ्रातरौ तौ महारथौ। ववर्ष शरवर्षेण सारथिं चाप्यपातयत्॥
en: Thereupon, inflamed with wrath, Iravat poured an arrow downpour on the two brothers both mighty car-warriors; and he felled their charioteer.

sa: कुशस्तम्बः कुशद्वीपे मध्ये जनपदैः सह। सम्पूज्यते शाल्पलिश्च द्वीपे शाल्मलिके नृप॥
en: O king, along with the kingdoms in these islands, Kusha grass in Kushadvipa and the Salami tree is Shalmalikadvipa are worshipped.

sa: लक्ष्मणेन यदानीतं पीतं वारि महात्मना। औपवास्यं तदकार्षीद् राघवः सह सीतया॥
en: Thus did that magnanimous one beseech us. On the high-souled Lakşmaņa bringing water, Rāghava having drunk it, fasted along with Sītā.

sa: एतच्चछ्रुत्वा तु राधेयः क्रोधादुत्फाल्य लोचने। उवाच भीष्मं राधेयस्तुदन् वाग्भिः प्रतोदवत्॥१०
en: Hearing this, the son of Radha, expanding his eyes in wrath, said to Bhishma piercing him with his hook of words.

sa: स तं निर्जित्य कौन्तेयो नातितीव्रण कर्मणा॥ पूर्वदेशं महावीर्यो विजिग्ये कुरुनन्दन॥
en: Having vanquished that king by performing feats that excelled in fierceness, the greatly powerful descendant of Kuru subjugated the eastern region.

sa: सगणं रावणं हत्वा राघवो रघुनन्दनः। त्वामादाय वरारोहे स्वपुरीं प्रति यास्यति॥
en: And slaying Rāvaņa together with his adherents, Raghu's son, taking you, O paragon among women, shall return to his own city.

sa: आभिमन्योर्विनाशेन न शर्म लभतेऽर्जुनः। स कथं मद्धिते यत्नं प्रकरिष्यति याचितः॥
en: Arjuna also, in consequence of Abhimanyu's death, has become very miserable. Even if requested, why will he try for iny good?

sa: मद् द्वितीयं पुनः पार्थं कः प्रार्थयितुमर्हति। युद्धे प्रतीपमायान्तमपि साक्षात् पुरंदरः॥
en: Who can wish to defeat him having me as his help when he goes to the battle field like Indra (himself)?

sa: तपस्तप्यन्ति ते तीव्र भवन्ति झूर्ध्वरेतसः। रक्षणार्थं तु भूतानां प्रविशन्ते दिवाकरम्॥
en: The undergo severe asceticism. They have their passions under complete control. They all enter the sun for the protection of creation.

sa: निरामयाश्च ते लोका नित्यं मुदितमानसाः॥ दश वर्षसहस्राणि दश वर्षशतानि च। जीवन्ति ते महाराज न चान्योन्यं जहत्युत॥ भारुण्डा नाम शकुनास्तीक्ष्णतुण्डा महाबलाः। तान् निर्हरन्तीह मृतान् दरीषु प्रक्षिपन्ति च॥ उत्तराः कुरवो राजन् व्याख्यातास्ते समासतः।
en: The dwellers of this region are free from diseases. They are ever happy. O king, they live ten thousand and ten hundred years and they never abandon one another. A kind of birds called Bharunda of sharp beaks and of great strength takes them up when dead and throws them into the mountain caves. O king, I have now described to you the northern Kuru.

sa: ततो विविक्त एकान्ते तस्थौ बुद्धिमतां वरः। विदुरो वृक्षमाश्रित्य कच्चितत्र वनान्तरे॥
en: Having reached a solitary spot in the forest that foremost of intelligent men, viz., Vidura, stood still, learning against a tree.

sa: यद् भीमसेनः समरे पुत्रान् मम विचेतसः। अहन्यहनि संक्रुद्धो नयते यमसादनम्॥
en: In as much as, day by day, waxing worth in battle, Bhimasena is dispatching my sons to the abode of death.

sa: अङ्गदस्य वचः श्रुत्वा सुग्रीवः सचिवैः सह। लक्ष्मणं कुपितं श्रुत्वा मुमोचासनमात्मवान्॥
en: Hearing the words of Angada as well as of Laksmana's wrath, the self-controlled Sugriva along with his counsellors, left his seat.

sa: स राजा सत्यवाग् देव्या वरदानमनुस्मरन्। मुमोह वचनं श्रुत्वा कैकेय्याः क्रूरमप्रियम्॥
en: The monarch was truthful and remembering his vow and hearing the unpleasant and vile words of Kaikeyi lost himself (in grief).

sa: तं पौष्यः प्रविश्यान्तःपुरं क्षत्रिया याच्यतामिति। स तेनैवमुक्तः प्रविश्यान्तःपुरं क्षत्रियां नापश्यत्॥
en: King Paushya said “Go into the innerapartment and ask it from the queen.” He went there, but could not see her.

sa: तास्तु सर्वा विशालाक्ष्यो रूपेणाप्रतिमा भुवि। अत्यात्यत तासां तु रोहिणी रूपसम्पदा॥
en: Endued with large eyes, all of them were peerless in beauty in the world. In beauty however, Rohini excelled them all.

sa: कृपणं विलपन्ना” जरयाभिपरिप्लुतः। म्रियते रुद्रतां मध्ये ज्ञातीनां न स पूरुषः॥
en: He is no man who dies miserably crying in agony, afflicted by disease and decay in the midst of crying kinsmen.

sa: नक्षत्रयोगनिरताः संख्यानार्थं च ताभवन्। पल्यो वै तस्य राजेन्द्र सोमस्य शुभकर्मणः॥
en: Connected with the several constellations, those wives, O king, of Soma of glorious deeds, served to help men in calculating time.

sa: भीमसेनेन तत्रोक्तो धृतराष्टात्मजेति च। सम्बोध्य प्रहसित्वा च इतो द्वारं नराधिप॥
en: O king, Bhimasena laughed aloud, and addressing me, he spoke thus to me. "O son of Dhritarashtra, this is the doer".

sa: रामक्षयं विदित्वा ते सर्व एव समागताः॥ तवानुगमने राजन्संप्राप्ताः स्म समागताः। यदि राम विनास्माभिर्गच्छेस्त्वं पुरुषोचम॥ यमदण्डमिवोद्यम्य त्वया स्म विनिपातिताः। एतस्मिन्नन्तरे रामं सुग्रीवोऽपि महाबलः। प्रणम्य विधिवद्वीरं विज्ञापयितुमुद्यतः।२१॥ अभिषिच्याङ्गदं वीरमागतोऽस्मि नरेश्वर। तवानुगमने राजन्विद्धिमां कृतनिश्चयम्॥
en: All they came there knowing the departure of Rāma to heaven and said: "O Răma, O foremost of men, if you do repair to heaven forsaking us all, it will be hurling Yama's rod upon us.” The highly powerful Sugrīva too saluting Rāma said:— lord of men, having placed Angada on the throne I have come hither. I have determined upon following you, O King.

sa: अप्यदृष्टं श्रवादेव पुरुषं धर्मचारिणम्। भूतिकर्माणि कुर्वाणं तं जनाः कुर्वते प्रियम्॥
en: People regard that who righteously and who does good acts even if they only hear of him without actually seeing him.

sa: भीष्म उवाच तयोः संवदतोरेवं राजन् रामाम्बयोस्तदा। ऋषिः परमधर्मात्मा इदं वचनमब्रवीत्॥
en: Bhishma said While the two, Amba and Rama, were thus conversing together, the Rishi, of extremely virtuous soul, said these words:

sa: इमांस्तु नैच्छत् स्वाज्ञातीन् रक्षितुं च सखा तव।।१७। ततः पुत्रांश्च पौत्रांश्च भ्रातृनथ सखींस्तथा। शयानान् निहतान् दृष्ट्वा ततो मामब्रवीदिदम्॥ सम्प्राप्तोऽद्यायमस्यान्तः कुलस्य भरतर्षभ।
en: That friend, however, of yours did not wish to protect his kinsmen. Seeing his sons and grandson and brothers and friends lying dead, he said to me these words, O Bharata's race. The destruction of this our family has at last come.

sa: कृष्णस्य संनिधौ रामः सहित: कृतवर्मणा। अपिबद् युयुधानश्च गदो बभ्रुस्तथैव च॥
en: In the very sight of Krishna, Rama began to drink, with Kritavarman, Yuyudhana and Gada and Vabhru also did the same.

sa: आतिथ्यं प्रतिगृह्णन्ति तत्र तत्र महर्षयः। अर्चितेषु प्रलीनेषु तेष्वन्यद् रोचते वनम्॥
en: There, in various places, the great Rishis accept hospitality. When they, having been adored become annihilated, then another forest shines forth.

sa: त्वद्वचः सत्यमेवास्तु जहि पार्थान् समागतान्। सोमकांश्च महेष्वासान् सत्यवाग् भव भारत॥
en: The Panchalas, the Kauravas, O Bharata.' These were your words to me, verify them by slaying the assembled sons of Pritha,

sa: तेषां: संवदतां तत्र वायुः प्रादुर्बभूव ह॥ कम्पयन् मेदिनी सर्वां पातयंश्च महादुमान्। तमसा संवृतः सूर्यः सर्वे नावेदिषुर्दिशः॥ भस्मना चावृतं सर्वं सम्मूढमिव तद्बलम्।
en: As they were thus conversing, there blew a strong wind; and all the earth began to speak; and the trees to topple down. And a deep gloom enveloped the sun; and no quarter could be discovered. And enveloped in ashes, that host became stupefied.

sa: निहत्य दितिपुत्रांस्तु राज्यं प्राप्य पुरंदरः। शशास मुदितो लोकान् सर्षिसङ्घान् सचारणान्॥
en: Having slaughtered the sons of Diti's and regained his kingdom, he happily began to rule the worlds, containing saints and Caranas.

sa: कचिदाशास्ति देवानां प्रसादं पार्थिवात्मजः। कच्चित् पुरुषकारं च दैवं च प्रतिपद्यते॥
en: Is that son of the king invoking the blessings of the celestials? Has he attained manliness and assistance from the celestials?

sa: एतेन त्वां नरेन्द्रोऽयं कारुण्येन समाप्लुतः। शोकैः संक्लिष्टवदनो न शक्नोति निरीक्षितुम्॥
en: The king, filled with pity and having his face marked with the affliction of sorrow, cannot cast a glance upon you.

sa: मत्प्रसादान ते राज्ञि भविता दोष इत्युत। एवमुक्त्वा स भगवान्कुन्तिराजसुतां तदा॥
en: "O princess, there will be no sin in gratifying me." Having said this to the daughter of Kuntibhoja, that illustrious deity.

sa: कर्णश्चैव महेष्वासः सर्वशस्त्रभृतां वरः। स गतः परमां सिद्धिं यदर्थं परितप्यसे॥
en: Karna the powerful bowman, that foremost of all wielders of weapons, for whom you are grieving, has also acquired high success.

sa: सौतिरुवाच एवमुक्तस्तु विप्रेण स राजा जनमेजयः। अर्चयित्वा यथान्यायं प्रत्युवाच द्विजोत्तमम्॥
en: Sauti said: Having been thus addressed by the Brahmana, king Janamejaya duly saluted him and said to the best of Brahmanas.

sa: चित्राङ्गदा ययौ चापि मणिपूरपुरं प्रति। शिष्टाः परिक्षितं त्वन्या मातरः पर्यवारयन्॥
en: The princess Chitrangada started for the capital of Manipur. The other ladies who were the grandmothers of Parikshit gathered around him.

sa: एष मुष्टिर्महान् बद्धो गाढः सुनियताङ्गुलिः। मया वेगविमुक्तस्ते प्राणानादाय यास्यति ॥
en: Behold, I have clinched this terrible fist, arranging close my fingers; and one blow from me will take away your life.

sa: ततो दुर्योधनो राजा सर्वांस्तानाह मन्त्रिणः। सूतपुत्रं समाभाष्य सौबलं च महाबलम्॥
en: Thereafter king Duryodhana, addressing the son of Suta and the highly powerful son of Subala, spoke to all his counselors thus

sa: तद्वाक्यं भरतेनोक्तं प्रतिजग्राह राघवः। तं च कृत्वा वशे देशमङ्गदस्य न्यवेशयत्॥
en: Rāma approved of the words of Bharata and having brought the country of Kārupatha under his subjection gave it to Angada.

sa: दुष्प्रणीतेन मनसा दुष्प्रणीततरा कृतिः। मनो बद्ध्यति येनेह शृणु वाक्यं शुभानने।॥
en: Listen to me, Oyou of sweet face, how also a mind of illregulated features, becomes fettered by illregulated or evil thoughts.

sa: उपर्युपरि राज्ञां वै ज्वलित्वा भास्करो यथा॥ युधिष्ठिरं कथं पश्यादनुयास्यामि दासवत्।
en: Having spread rays like the sun upon the heads of all the kings, how shall I walk behind Yudhishthira as slave?

sa: तच्छ्रुत्वा हृष्टमनसौ दिवं तौ प्रतिजग्मतुः। च्यवनश्च सुकन्या च सुराविव विजह्रतुः॥
en: Having heard this, the two (Ashvins) cheerfully went to heaven. Chyavana and Sukanya also passed happily their days like (two) celestials.

sa: अथ रात्र्यां व्यतीतायां विश्वामित्रो महामुनिः। आपृष्ट्वा तौ च राजानौ जगामोत्तरपर्वतम्॥
en: Then when the right had passed away, the mighty Muni Viśvāmitra, having greeted the monarchs, yet out for the Northern mountains.

sa: विग्रहो हि महाप्राज्ञ स्वजनेन विगर्हितः। अधर्म्यमयशस्यं च मा राजन् प्रतिपद्यताम्॥
en: O greatly intelligent man, dissension with relatives is improper. It is sinful and reprehensible. O king, you should desist from it.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच एवमुक्तस्तु कौन्तेयो गुडाकेशेन पाण्डवः। नोवाच किंचित् कौरव्यस्ततो द्वैपायनोऽब्रवीत्॥
en: Vaishampayana said Thus addressed by Arjuna of curly hair, the Kuru king, son of Kunti, remained silent. Then Dvaipayana (Vyasa) said.

sa: अनीकानां च संह्रादे वादित्राणां च निःस्वने। प्रध्यापितेषु शोषु संनादे लोमहर्षणे॥
en: When the soldiers uttered loud war-cries and musical instruments emitted tremendous din, when conchs were blown and horripilating roars were heard.

sa: नहि त्वां रावणो दृष्ट्वा दिव्यरूपां मनोरमाम्। मर्षयत्यचिरं सीते स्वगृहे पर्यवस्थिताम्॥
en: O Sita, (I do not think) Ravana has overlooked you, who lived in his house, beholding you so graceful and beautiful.

sa: तस्मिन्नेवंगते शब्दे दिव्ये श्रोत्रसुखे नृणाम्। ददर्श भारतं सैन्यं विधानं विश्वकर्मणः॥
en: When that celestial symphony delightful to the ears of men, had thus developed itself, Bharata's forces saw the workmanship of Visvakarman.

sa: क्षीयमाणे तु लोकेऽस्मिन्संभ्रान्तनसः सुराः। यदुक्तं विष्णुना पूर्वं तं यज्ञं समुपानयन्॥
en: In this wise, the celestials being stricken with anxiety, according to the previous command of Visnu, engaged in celebrating the sacrifice.

sa: नारदस्य वचः श्रुत्वा राजा वचनमब्रवीत्। देवानामन्त्र्य धर्मात्मा स्वपक्षांश्चैव पार्थिवान्॥ शुभं वा यदि वा पापं भ्रातृणां स्थानमद्य मे। तदेव प्राप्तुमिच्छामि लोकानन्यान्न कामये॥
en: Hearing these words of Narada, the righteous-souled king, saluting the celestials and all the royal sages there present, said, ‘Happy or miserable, whatever the region be that is now any brothers, I wish to proceed to. I do not wish to go anywhere else.'

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच हिडिम्बा तु ततः कुन्तीमभिवाद्य कृताञ्जलिः। युधिष्ठिरं तु कौन्तेयमिदं वचनमब्रवीत्॥ आर्ये जानासि यद् दुःखमिह स्त्रीणामनङ्गजम्। तदिदं मामनुप्राप्तं भीमसेनकृतं शुभे॥
en: Vaishampayana said : Thereupon, Hidimba respectfully saluting Kunti and Yudhisthira with joined hands, spoke to Kunti thus, “O respected lady, you know the pangs that women suffer from the god of love. O blessed lady, I have received those (pangs) by Bhima.

sa: तत्र यज्ञे ययातेश्च महाराज सरस्वती। सर्पिः पयश्च सुस्राव नाहुषस्य महात्मनः॥
en: There, O king, at the sacrifice of the highsouled Yayati, the son of Nahusha, the Sarasvati produced milk and clarified butter.

sa: तं शयानमुपागम्य पृथिव्यां पृथिवीपतिम्। विदुरः सर्वधर्मज्ञ इदं वचनमब्रवीत्॥ उत्तिष्ठ राजन् किं शेषे मा शुचो भरतर्षभ। एषा वै सर्वसत्त्वानां लोकेश्वर परा गतिः॥
en: Approaching the king, who was lying prostrate on the Earth, Vidura, conversant with all forms of duty, said: 'Rise, O king, why do you lie down thus? Do not grieve, O foremost of Bharata's! This O king, is the final end of all creatures.

sa: ततस्तु संवृतो भीमस्तावकान् निशितैः शरैः। पीडयामास तान् सर्वान् सहस्राक्ष इवासुरान्॥
en: Thus surrounded by those warriors, Bhima began to assail them all with sharp arrows like the thousand-eyed deity assailing the Asuras.

sa: यज्ञ देहि प्रजां रक्ष धर्म समनुपालय। अमित्राञ्जहि कौन्तेय मित्राणि परिपालय॥
en: Celebrate sacrifices, distribute alms, protect your subjects, and practise righteousness. Kill your enemies, O son of Kunti, and protect your friends.

sa: अक्षौहिण्यो हताश्चाष्टौ दश चैव विशाम्पते॥ निर्जनेयं वसुमती शून्या सम्प्रति केवला।
en: Eight and ten Akshauhinis of warriors, O king, have been killed. The Earth had become desolate, and is almost empty now.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच श्रुत्वैतदप्रियं राजा धृतराष्ट्रोऽम्बिकासुतः। पपात भूमौ निश्चेष्टश्छिन्नमूल इव द्रुमः॥
en: Vaishampayana said Hearing that evil news the Kuru king Dhritarashtra fell down on a sudden on the ground from his seat.

sa: इति सर्वान् गुणानेतान् यथोक्तान् योऽनुवर्तते। अनुभूयेह भद्राणि प्रेत्य स्वर्गे महीयते॥
en: That king, who observes all these virtues that I have mentioned, enjoys many blessings of Earth and great rewards in heaven.'

sa: अभक्ष्या ब्राह्मणैर्मत्स्याः शल्कैर्ये वै विवर्जिताः। चतुष्यात् कच्छपादन्यो मण्डूका जलजाश्च ये॥
en: They should also abstain from eating fishes that have scales, and four-legged aquatic animals like frogs and others, except the tortoise.

sa: आपवस्तु ततो रोषाच्छशापार्जुनमच्युत। दग्धेऽऽश्रमे महाबाहो कार्तवीर्येण वीर्यवान्॥ त्वया न वर्जितं यस्मान्नमेदं हि महद् वनम्। दग्धं तस्माद् रणे रामो बाहूंस्ते छेत्स्यतेऽर्जुन॥
en: O mighty-armed king, seeing his hermitage consumed by the powerful Kshatriya, the highly energetic Apava cursed that monarch in anger, saying,-Since, O Arjuna, without reserving these my woods, you have burnt them, therefore, Rama (of Bhrigu's race), will cut your thousand arins.

sa: दृष्ट्वाहं तं कृशं विप्रं भीतः परमदुर्मनाः। पादौ तस्याभिवाद्याथ स्थितः प्राञ्जलिरग्रतः॥
en: Seeing that highly emaciated Brahmana I became very dispirited and frightened. Saluting his feet, I stood before him with clasped hands.

sa: गुणवन्तो महोत्साहा धर्मज्ञाः साधवश्च ये। संदधीत नृपस्तैश्च राष्ट्र धर्मेण पालयन्॥
en: Engaged in protecting his kingdom piously the king should make peace with accomplished persons capable of great work, virtuous and honest.

sa: तस्मिन्ननिर्जिते युद्धे प्राणान् यदि विमोक्ष्यसे। अन्यं देहं समास्थाय ततस्तैरपि योत्स्यसे॥
en: If you expire before conquering in this battle, then, assuming another body, you shall have to fight these very enemies again.

sa: दृष्ट्वोपविष्टां राजर्षिः पाण्डवो महिषीं प्रियाम्। प्रत्युवाच स धर्मात्मा द्रौपदी चारुदर्शनाम्॥ धर्म्य धर्मेण धर्मज्ञे प्राप्तास्ते निधनं शुभे। पुत्रास्ते भ्रातरश्चैव तान्न शोचितुमर्हसि॥
en: Seeing his dear queen sit in Praya, the royal and pious sage Yudhishthira addressed her, saying,-'O auspicious lady, you do not follow the code of morality, your sons and brothers have met with a noble death. You should not grieve for them.

sa: संशयस्तु महाप्राज्ञ संजातो हृदये मम तन्मुने मम तत्त्वेन वक्तुमर्हसि पृच्छतः॥
en: O you of great wisdom, one doubt, however, is in my mind. You should, O sage, explain it fully to me.

sa: जयं मत्वाऽऽत्मनश्चैत श्रान्ता व्यायामकर्शिताः। तेषां निशि प्रसुप्तानां सुस्थानां शिविरे स्वके॥
en: While sleeping easily during the night within their own camp, I shall make a great and terrible assault upon their camp.

sa: अमात्यरक्षा प्रणिधी राजपुत्रस्य लक्षणम्। चारश्च विविधोपायः प्रणिधेयः पृथग्विधः॥ साम भेदः प्रदानं च ततो दण्डच पार्थिव। उपेक्षा पञ्चमी चात्र कात्स्न्येन समुदाहृता॥
en: The subjects also of behaviour towards ministers, of spies, the indications of princes, of secret agents, of envoys and agents of other kinds, conciliation, sowing seeds of discord, gifts, and punishment, O king, with toleration as the fifth, were fully described there.

sa: आसाद्य भीमसेन तु संरब्धा युद्धदुर्मदाः। विनेशुः सहसा दृष्ट्वा भूतग्रामा इवान्तकम्॥
en: The maddened warriors, whom it was difficult to vanquish in battle, perished in no time like creatures on seeing Death himself,

sa: सिंहनादाच भीमस्य पाञ्चजन्यस्वेनन च। गाण्डीवस्य च निर्घोषात् सम्मुह्यन्ते मनांसि नः॥
en: At the leonine shouts of Bhimasena and the blare of Panchajanya and the twang of Gandiva, our hearts will be paralyzed.

sa: तथैव नकुलः शूरः सौबलस्य सुतं रणे॥ शरवर्षेण महता समन्तात् पर्यवारयत्।
en: The heroic Nakula, however, in that battle opposed the son of Shakuni with a dense shower of arrows from every side.

sa: चतुष्पदी हि नि:श्रेणी ब्रह्मण्येव प्रतिष्ठिता। तां क्रमेण महाबाहो यथावज्जय पार्थिव॥
en: Four modes of life and laid down in the Vedas. Do you, O king, duly pass through them one after another.

sa: जयद्रथे च निहते राक्षसे चाप्यलायुधे। बाह्निके सोमदत्ते च नैवाशाम्यत वैशसम्॥
en: After the fall of Jayadratha, of the Rakshasa Alayudha, of Valhika and of Somadatta the killing battle did not still stop.

sa: संदर्शेनैव सेनाया भयं भीरून् प्रबाधते। वज्रादिव प्रज्वलितादियं क्व नु पतिष्यति॥
en: On seeing a hostile army, fear paralyses the timid, as on seeing a thunderbolt they ask,-Oh upon what would it fall?

sa: तेषामापततां तूर्णं पुत्रस्ते भरतर्षभ॥ प्रासेन चेकितानं वै विव्याध हृदयं भृशम्।
en: Then your son, O foremost of Bharatas, aiming at Chekitana amongst them, cut him deeply with a lance in the chest.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच ततोऽभिषेकसम्भारान् सर्वान् सम्भृत्य शास्त्रतः। बृहस्पतिः समिद्धेऽग्नौ जुहावाग्निं यथाविधि॥
en: Vaishampayana said "Collecting all articles sanctioned by Shastras for the ceremony of investiture. Brihaspati duly poured libations of the burning fire.

sa: तमर्जुनः पृषत्कानां शतेन भरतर्षभ॥ पूरयित्वा ततो वाहान् प्राहरत् तस्य धन्विनः।
en: Covering him, first, O foremost of Bharata's race, with a hundred arrows Arjuna then killed all the horses of that bowman,

sa: महता रथयुद्धेन कोटिशः क्षत्रिया हताः। तथाभूच्च मही कीर्णा क्षत्रियैर्वदतां वर॥
en: In dreadful car-encounters millions of Kshatriyas were killed. The Earth, O foremost of orators, was covered with the corpses of Kshatriyas.

sa: कर्णपुत्रवधं दृष्ट्वा नकुलस्य च विक्रमम्। प्रदुद्राव भयात् सेना तावकी भरतर्षभ॥
en: Seeing the destruction of Karna's son and the power of Nakula, your army, O best of Bharatas, fled away in fear.

sa: एवं हि क्षत्रबन्धूनां मार्गमाहुः प्रधानतः। तस्माद् राज्ञा विशेषेण योद्धव्यं धर्ममीप्सता।।१८
en: Gifts, study, and sacrifices, yield prosperity to kings. Therefore, a king who desires to obtain religious merit should engage in battle.

sa: स प्रविश्य पुरीं सूतो भुजावुच्छ्रित्य दुखितः। वेपमानस्ततो राज्ञः प्रविवेश निकेतनम्॥
en: Having entered the city and raising up his arms in sorrows and trembling the charioteer entered the Palace of the king.

sa: हताश्वं नकुलं दृष्ट्वा वृषसेनेन संयुगे। भ्रातृणां सम्प्रहृष्टानां त्रासः संजानितो मया॥
en: Seeing Nakula deprived of his horses by Vrishasena in battle, I caused the rejoicing Kaurava brothers to be filled with fear.

sa: यथा हि भगवानग्निर्जगद् दग्ध्वा चराचरम्॥ विधूमो दृश्यते राजंस्तथा पार्थो धनंजयः।
en: As the illustrious Agni blazes forth for destroying the immobile and the immobile creation so. O king, mighty car-warrior Partha looked.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच तच्छ्रुत्वा वासुदेवस्य पुनरुक्तं वचोऽप्रियम्। तूष्णीं बभूव गान्धारी शोकव्याकुललोचना॥
en: Vaishampayana said Hearing these words of Vasudeva that were unpleasant to her, Gandhari, with heart stricken greatly with grief, remained silent.

sa: तं पिबन् पाणिमिन्द्रस्य शतमह्ना व्यवर्धत। स आसीद् द्वादशसमो द्वादशाहेन पार्थिवः॥
en: Sucking Indra's finger, he grew up in a hundred days. In twelve days he looked like a boy of twelve years,

sa: वयमेवास्य लोकस्य विनाशे कारणं स्मृताः। धृतराष्ट्रस्य पुत्रेषु तत् सर्वं प्रतिपत्स्यति॥
en: We are the root of the destruction that has overtaken the world. The fault, however, should be attributed the of Dhritarashtra.

sa: अवेक्षमाणा तं बाला कृष्ण त्वामभिभाषते। अयं ते पुण्डरीकाक्ष सदृशाक्षो निपातितः॥
en: Beholding her lord, O Krishna, that girl addresses you saying:-'O lotus-eyed one, this hero whose eyes resembled yours, has been killed.

sa: अन्वीयमानो वीरेण दाशार्हेण महात्मना। युयुधानेन च तथा तथैव च युयुत्सुना॥
en: The son of Kunti was followed by the great and heroic Krishna of Dasharha's race, by Yuyudhana, as also by Yuyutsu.

sa: तदन्तं हि भवेद् वैरमनुमानेन माधव॥ एवं पश्यामि वार्ष्णेय चिन्तयन् प्रज्ञया स्वया। विदुरस्य च वाक्येन चेष्टया च दुरात्मनः॥ तस्माद् याहि चमू वीर यावद्धन्मि शितैः शरैः। दुर्योधनं महाबाहो वाहिनीं चास्य संयुगे॥
en: That will terminate these hostilities. Exercising my reason, O Madhava and reflecting in my own mind, O Vrishni heroe, thinking of Vidura's words and taking into account the acts of the wicked Duryodhana himself, I have arrived at this conclusion. Enter into Kuru division, O hero, for I shall kill the wicked Duryodhana and his army today with my keen arrows.

sa: ऋतवश्च सुखाः सर्वे भवन्त्युत निरामयाः। प्रसीदन्ति नराणां च स्वरवर्णमनांसि च॥
en: All the seasons are delightful and free from evil. The voice pronunciation, and minds of all men became clear and delightful.

sa: प्रसन्नो हि महादेवो दद्यादमरतामपि। वीर्यं च गिरिशो दद्याद् येनेन्द्रमपि शातयेत्॥
en: If Mahadeva is pleased he can grant even immortality! Girisha can give such courage as will succeed in checking Indra himself.

sa: शल्यं सेनापतिं कृत्वा विधिवद् राजपुङ्गवः। रणाय निर्ययौ राजा हतशैषैर्नृपैः सह॥
en: Having appointed duly Shalya as the coihmander-in-chief, that foremost of kings, O king, went out for battle with the remaining chiefs.

sa: तस्मात् सर्वं व्यपोह्यार्थं कार्य एव पराक्रमः। सर्वस्वमपि संत्यज्य कार्यमात्महितं नरैः॥
en: Therefore casting of everything else, one should display his energy. Indeed, disregarding everything, men should do what does good to themselves.

sa: न चोपलेभे भगवाञ्छकः प्रहरणं तदा॥ यद्वैतेषां भवेद् योग्यं वधाय विबुधद्विषाम्।
en: The king of the celestials, however, failed to find such weapons as were fit to kill the enemies of the celestials.

sa: हतशिष्टाश्च राजानः कृत्स्नं चैव समागतम्। चातुर्वण्र्यं महाराज राष्ट्रं ते कुरुजाङ्गलम्॥
en: The surviving kings, and the people belonging to all the four orders of your kingdom of Kurujangala, O king, are here.

sa: नरा विनिहताः सर्वे गजाश्च विनिपातिताः। रथिनश्च नरव्याघ्र हयाश्च निहता युधि॥
en: All the men collected have been destroyed as also the elephants. All the car-warriors and horses have been slain in battle.
